# ParcelProof: survey parcel checks and cadastral submission review

## Purpose and limits
A small land-surveying firm needs to turn approved survey points into checked parcel schedules and reviewed cadastral submissions. The pilot covers 15 projects, each with at most 30 parcels and 200 boundary vertices per parcel. Coordinates are integer millimetres in a named project reference system. The service does not operate surveying instruments, transform coordinate systems, determine ownership, design buildings, value land or manage easements. Synthetic point files and parcel outlines are available; external credentials, accounts and submission authorizations are absent.

## Survey points
A survey technician can preview a point file containing project_id, point_id, easting_mm, northing_mm and evidence_reference. Missing fields, noninteger coordinates or duplicate point identifiers reject the entire file with row-level reasons and no changes. Point identifiers are unique within a project. Reimporting identical point content is a no-op; changed coordinates require a reasoned revision preserving the original values, actor and time. A licensed surveyor approves point revisions for use in parcel checks. Imported but unapproved points remain visible and cannot support an approved parcel schedule.

## Parcel geometry and measurements
A technician records each parcel's identifier and ordered boundary point identifiers. All points must belong to the same project and reference system. An outline must repeat its first point at the end, contain at least three distinct vertices and have no consecutive coincident coordinates. Reject an open outline, a zero-length edge, a self-crossing boundary or a boundary touching itself anywhere except its closing endpoint. Do not reorder vertices, snap coordinates or repair geometry automatically. Report the reason a parcel cannot be measured.

For a valid outline, calculate area from its coordinates using the shoelace rule, taking the absolute result so clockwise and counterclockwise outlines give the same area. Retain the unrounded area for comparisons; display square metres to two decimal places with exact halves rounded upward. The schedule must also show each edge's endpoint identifiers and length in metres to three decimal places. Display rounding must not change geometry validation. Point validation and geometry checks can be planned separately with synthetic examples before external cadastral access exists.

The technician can declare two parcels adjoining and name their shared boundary chains. Their shared geometry must coincide exactly in reverse traversal; extra collinear intermediate vertices are acceptable. Any positive-area overlap between project parcels is an error, while a shared edge is allowed. A gap between declared adjoining chains is an error even if small. Do not average the boundaries or invent a tolerance. Unrelated parcels need not touch.

## Boundary dispute and review
For parcel P-7, the signed deed sketch states “the western boundary follows points A–B,” while the client's signed instruction states “the western boundary follows points C–D.” The two lines differ, both documents are described as mandatory, and no precedence decision exists. The client's conveyancer must supply an authoritative resolution. Preserve both claims without selecting one. P-7's approved schedule and submission remain blocked; other parcels and project point review can proceed. Candidate P-7 outlines may be checked locally only when clearly labeled disputed and unapproved.

A licensed surveyor can approve a versioned parcel schedule only when its points are approved, geometry and adjoining checks pass, and relevant disputes are resolved. Changes to supporting points, outlines or adjoining declarations make affected approvals stale. Previously submitted schedules remain immutable; corrections require a newly reviewed amendment linked to the original submission. The overview must expose unapproved points, geometry errors, adjoining mismatches, disputes, stale approvals and submission outcomes. Users disagree whether it should initially group parcels by client reference or parcel identifier; either is acceptable and must not change checks.

## External submission and authority
The cadastral agency is expected to accept parcel schedules and amendments and return lodgement outcomes. Its endpoint, authentication, firm permissions, required reference-system identification, coordinate precision, package schema and duplicate-lodgement behavior are unknown. These block live submission, not local checks. Do not assume that agency receipt establishes ownership or legal registration.

Before any attempt, the firm's principal surveyor must separately authorize the exact approved package version, project, parcel set and destination. This brief grants no execution permission. Schedule approval is not submission authorization. Changed package or destination details invalidate authorization. Immediately before sending, reject stale or unauthorized packages rather than silently rebuilding them. Preserve rejected, received, registered and unknown outcomes; registered status requires the agency's explicit registration evidence. A timeout is unknown and requires documented outcome resolution before another attempt, without automatic retry. Link outcomes to the attempted package and authorization.

Technicians import points and prepare outlines and adjoining declarations; licensed surveyors approve points and schedules; only the principal surveyor authorizes submission. Viewers can read schedules. Enforce permissions beyond screen visibility. The service records the conveyancer's dispute resolution without deciding ownership itself.

## Acceptance and delivery expectations
A closed rectangle 10,000 mm by 20,000 mm has area 200.00 m², regardless of traversal direction. A 10,001 mm by 5,000 mm rectangle has exact area 50.005 m² and displays 50.01 m². Omitting the repeated starting point rejects the outline. A crossing bow-tie outline fails rather than receiving an area. Two squares sharing an edge may pass; a one-millimetre gap between their declared adjoining chains fails. An approved schedule becomes stale after a supporting point revision. P-7 is not approved before authoritative resolution.

Evidence, revisions, approvals and submission history must survive restart with unchanged check results. Local storage, preview layout and initial grouping may use explicitly labeled reversible assumptions; these are not customer approvals. Describe verification as proposed work: no implementation, executed tests or live-agency evidence is supplied.

architecture: Proposed architecture: a local application with separate point-import, exact-geometry, dispute, schedule-review and submission-control modules, backed by a durable local repository. Storage technology remains a reversible, unapproved assumption; no implementation is claimed. [SRC-6b542474745b]

The geometry module accepts explicit project/reference-system point snapshots, including supplied synthetic examples. Its planning and verification do not depend on the point-import implementation or external agency access. Review workflows subsequently connect these modules. [SRC-a7d7ce97cce4, SRC-128c5a7f7579]

Proposed numeric design: use integer/rational predicates for geometry and retain absolute doubled shoelace area, converting to square metres without losing the unrounded value. Apply area rounding only for display. Edge-length exact-half rounding upward remains unapproved assumption ASM-2b41eb962d73. [SRC-a7d7ce97cce4, SRC-57abaa680df7]

Keep versioned points, outlines, adjoining declarations and schedules, with explicit supporting-version references. Supporting changes invalidate affected approvals; submitted schedule snapshots remain immutable and amendments link to their originals. [SRC-4270870e33a7, SRC-6122493d946e]

Separate preservation of P-7's conflicting claims and disputed candidate checks from its resolved approval branch. W06 remains conditional on authoritative conveyancer resolution; W01–W05 can proceed without selecting a boundary. [SRC-2c7e94188caf]

Separate local package authorization, preflight, history and timeout safeguards from external transmission. An internal package model is a proposal, not an established agency schema or an executable submission authorization. [SRC-128c5a7f7579, SRC-eb160f704d1f]

Use distinct external-operation nodes for an initial eligible lodgement and any later attempt following an unknown outcome. Agency access blocks both; the unresolved recovery decision additionally blocks W08. Neither branch blocks local functionality. [SRC-128c5a7f7579, SRC-eb160f704d1f]
completion_definition: Proposed local acceptance: reject invalid point files atomically with row-level reasons; verify identical reimports, reasoned revisions, preserved originals and licensed-surveyor approval controls. [SRC-4270870e33a7]

Proposed geometry acceptance: reject open, zero-length, crossing and prohibited self-touching outlines without repair. Verify 200.00 m² for the stated rectangle in either traversal direction and exact 50.005 m² displayed as 50.01 m² for the second rectangle. Verify edge identifiers and three-decimal lengths. [SRC-409871b7556d, SRC-a7d7ce97cce4, SRC-5fbfc3bf87e5]

Proposed adjoining acceptance: accept exact reversed shared chains with collinear subdivisions, permit shared edges, reject positive-area overlaps and the stated one-millimetre declared gap, and permit separated unrelated parcels. [SRC-57abaa680df7, SRC-5fbfc3bf87e5]

Proposed review acceptance: enforce all approval prerequisites and role restrictions, stale affected approvals after each supporting change, preserve submitted schedules and require reviewed linked amendments. [SRC-6122493d946e, SRC-db02d85fb7ca]

Proposed dispute acceptance: retain both P-7 claims, permit only disputed/unapproved candidate checks, refuse unresolved P-7 approval and submission, and demonstrate independent progress for other parcels and point review. Positive P-7 approval acceptance remains conditional on actual authoritative resolution. [SRC-2c7e94188caf, SRC-5fbfc3bf87e5]

Proposed local submission-control acceptance: reject stale or mismatched authorizations without rebuilding, distinguish receipt from registration, retain linked outcomes, classify simulated timeouts as unknown and prevent automatic or unresolved repeat attempts. [SRC-eb160f704d1f]

Proposed overview and restart acceptance: display every required condition, retain evidence and history across restart and reproduce unchanged checks. Exercise pilot limits using synthetic inputs; grouping must not affect results. [SRC-6c8805b922f1, SRC-6122493d946e, SRC-6b542474745b]

Local acceptance can finish independently of W06–W08. Full live-integration acceptance remains incomplete until the agency contract, access, firm permissions and exact-package execution authorization exist; recovery acceptance additionally requires a defined documented-resolution procedure. [SRC-128c5a7f7579, SRC-eb160f704d1f]
All verification above is proposed work. The supplied material contains no implementation, executed tests or live-agency evidence. [SRC-6b542474745b]
data_entities: Project: project identifier and named reference system; coordinates remain integer millimetres. [SRC-6c8805b922f1]

Point and point revision: project-scoped point identifier, coordinates, evidence reference, preserved original values, revision reason, actor, time and surveyor approval. [SRC-4270870e33a7]
Parcel outline version: parcel identifier, ordered boundary point references and supporting point versions. [SRC-409871b7556d, SRC-6122493d946e]
Adjoining declaration version: parcel pair and named shared chains; check results distinguish exact reverse coincidence, gaps and positive-area overlaps. [SRC-57abaa680df7]
Measurement result: validation findings, unrounded area, displayed area and edges with endpoint identifiers and displayed metre lengths. [SRC-a7d7ce97cce4]
Boundary dispute: both P-7 claims and source documents, disputed status, candidate outlines and authoritative conveyancer resolution when supplied. [SRC-2c7e94188caf, SRC-db02d85fb7ca]
Schedule version and approval: supporting versions, measurements, review prerequisites, approving surveyor and current or stale approval state. [SRC-6122493d946e]

Submission package and authorization: exact package version, approved schedule references, project, parcel set, destination and separate principal-surveyor authorization. Agency serialization remains undefined. [SRC-128c5a7f7579, SRC-eb160f704d1f]

Submission attempt and outcome: attempted package, authorization, rejected/received/registered/unknown outcome, registration evidence when applicable and documented unknown-outcome resolution. [SRC-eb160f704d1f]
Submitted schedule and amendment linkage: immutable submitted snapshot and independently reviewed correction linked to the original submission. [SRC-6122493d946e]
interfaces: Local point interface: preview, atomic import, identical-content no-op, reasoned coordinate revision, point approval and visible approval state. Input file encoding and transport are not established by the brief. [SRC-4270870e33a7]

Local geometry interface: explicit project/reference-system point snapshot, ordered outlines and adjoining declarations in; measurement results and precise rejection reasons out. Never reorder, snap, repair, average or apply a tolerance. [SRC-409871b7556d, SRC-a7d7ce97cce4, SRC-57abaa680df7]

Local dispute interface: preserve claims, label candidate P-7 checks disputed and unapproved, and record an authoritative conveyancer resolution when supplied. No ownership decision is exposed. [SRC-2c7e94188caf, SRC-db02d85fb7ca]
Local review interface: approve an exact schedule version, inspect prerequisite failures and staleness, and create reviewed amendments without overwriting submitted snapshots. [SRC-6122493d946e]

Local submission-control interface: bind separate principal authorization to exact package details, invalidate mismatches, reject stale or unauthorized packages immediately before dispatch, and record linked outcomes without automatic retry. [SRC-eb160f704d1f]

Overview interface: expose all required point, geometry, adjoining, dispute, approval and outcome conditions. Initial parcel-identifier grouping remains reversible assumption ASM-119dba445426 and cannot change checks. [SRC-6122493d946e, SRC-6b542474745b]

External agency interface: endpoint, authentication, permissions, reference-system identification, precision, package schema, response interpretation and duplicate-lodgement behavior remain unresolved. No concrete API contract is asserted. [SRC-128c5a7f7579]

The unresolved P-7 decision does not block implementation or synthetic verification of these gates. [SRC-2c7e94188caf, SRC-6122493d946e, SRC-db02d85fb7ca]

[SRC-6122493d946e, SRC-eb160f704d1f, SRC-db02d85fb7ca, SRC-6b542474745b]

[SRC-128c5a7f7579, SRC-eb160f704d1f]

technical_risks: Floating-point predicates or rounded coordinates could miss self-touching, small gaps or overlaps. Exact arithmetic is proposed assumption ASM-2cd372b1da3e; its implementation and verification remain future work. [SRC-409871b7556d, SRC-a7d7ce97cce4, SRC-57abaa680df7]

Shared-chain comparison must accept extra collinear vertices while preserving reverse traversal. Overlap detection must also cover containment and undeclared parcel pairs, rather than treating every shared edge as overlap. [SRC-57abaa680df7]
Incomplete dependency tracking could leave approvals current after supporting changes. Schedule versions must identify supporting point, outline and adjoining-declaration versions. [SRC-6122493d946e]

Selecting either mandatory P-7 claim without authoritative resolution would invent precedence. Keeping its conditional branch separate prevents that conflict from blocking independent work. [SRC-2c7e94188caf]
An internal package representation may require revision after the agency contract becomes known. No current format can be claimed agency-compatible. [SRC-128c5a7f7579]

A timeout may hide an existing lodgement. Undefined duplicate handling and resolution evidence prevent safe acceptance of the positive retry branch; no automatic retry is permitted. [SRC-128c5a7f7579, SRC-eb160f704d1f]

ISS-c70edf298df8 and ISS-e8b835f8a7df remain non-blocking presentation ambiguities. Initial grouping and edge-length tie rounding are explicitly provisional, not customer-approved decisions. [SRC-6122493d946e, SRC-a7d7ce97cce4, SRC-6b542474745b]

Project identifiers, named reference systems, existing point versions and identical or changed reimport fixtures. [SRC-6c8805b922f1, SRC-4270870e33a7]
